svg.title: Initialize one repository: choose the matching route
svg.desc: Greenfield and brownfield are alternatives, not consecutive phases. Each has its own entry, scope and terminal result. Read the companion guide for conditions and all output details.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace

svg.text: INITIALIZATION • TWO ALTERNATIVES, NOT ONE SEQUENCE

text.font-family: Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: New project: interview. Existing source: isolated evidence collection.

text.font-family: Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Alternative 1: Initialize a new project from intent

svg.title: Initialize a new project from intent
svg.desc: Choose this route only when meaningful source does not yet exist. A decomposition persona is not an extra agent dispatch. Existing source selects the separate brownfield route. Actual endpoint: Five HTML knowledge documents, decomposition records holding the answered interview and confirmed intended architecture, promoted work on the task board, and native initialization. Unknowns stay recorded as unknown. Continue already-authorized work; population alone does not prove implementation or verification. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scaffold → resumable interview → confirm records → populate → initialize

svg.title: Choose the new-project route
svg.desc: command: /ca:init: scaffold once → command: /ca:decompose: selected strategy → skill: decompose: establish or resume drafts. A writable project-state scaffold and a valid new-project interview or explicit resume choice. An initialized project is not reinitialized.

path.title: no meaningful source: The stub must pass through its greenfield populator.
interview owner: The selected skill prepares persistence before questioning.

g.title: /ca:init: scaffold once. The scaffolder writes activation and empty state but no initialization sentinel. It refuses to overwrite existing state; an uninitialized stub enters its selected populator directly.

g.title: /ca:decompose: selected strategy. Automatic detection or --greenfield chooses the decomposition workflow. Source-shape mismatches remain stops rather than forced population.

g.title: decompose: establish or resume drafts. Create any missing knowledge documents and read the decomposition records. Answered questions stay settled; resume with the open question that matters most for the next step, not a fixed first-unfinished phase.

svg.title: Confirm the intended project
svg.desc: skill: decompose: record questions and answers → skill: decompose: synthesize records → skill: decompose: confirm the project definition. Capability, component, phase and work-item records the user confirmed. They describe intended architecture, not a typed feature execution plan or existing code.

path.title: complete durable input: Synthesis rereads the saved answers and linked decisions rather than trusting conversation memory.
user review: No population until the user confirms the records match their choices.

g.title: decompose: record questions and answers. Explore problem, users, capabilities, technical shape, integrations and risks in the order the conversation makes natural. Each question is saved when asked and each actual answer as soon as it is given. ADR attribution uses the decision-lifecycle owner; unresolved facts remain open questions.

g.title: decompose: synthesize records. From the answered questions and linked ADRs, add capability, component, phase and work-item decomposition records, each linked to the answers it rests on.

g.title: decompose: confirm the project definition. Show the synthesized records, apply corrections with record updates and save the user's actual confirmation as an answered question. A wording or method refinement needs no fresh confirmation; remaining gaps stay open questions.

svg.title: Populate and initialize
svg.desc: skill: decompose: populate project context → skill: decompose: native initialization. Five HTML knowledge documents, promoted work on the task board, the question board, audit header and native initialization. Decomposition holds intended design; the code map records only what code exists.

path.title: then initialize: Initialization records structural availability only; it does not require every question answered or any command run.

g.title: decompose: populate project context. Add knowledge records for what is known, each with its basis; planned commands stay proposed and unrun, and unknowns stay unknown. Promote each approved work item once with knowledge.py promote; decision-lifecycle owns actual ADR choices.

g.title: decompose: native initialization. knowledge.py initialize checks that the five knowledge documents exist and parse and the task board is well formed, then commits the initialization marker. Open questions do not prevent it; a refusal names the document to repair.

svg.text: Alternative 2: Initialize existing code from evidence

svg.title: Initialize existing code from evidence
svg.desc: Choose this route when meaningful source exists. Initial or full work covers six logical categories through direct bounded inspection or optional scoped agents; scoped refreshes cover only declared affected categories through context-check. Actual host permissions and excluded paths apply. An agent label does not prove containment or semantic correctness. Actual endpoint: Populated HTML knowledge records, each with its basis and cited sources, including a path-scoped code map. Material user-owned questions retain actual resolutions or explicit deferrals; other unknowns remain visible as unknown records. It does not invent a greenfield decomposition. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scaffold → inspect bounded source → record with basis → initialize

svg.title: Inspect bounded source evidence
svg.desc: command: /ca:init: scaffold once → command: /ca:create-context: selected strategy → skill: context-creation: confirm the source → skill: context-creation: direct or delegated inspection. Initial/full work accounts for all six categories with inspected evidence and explicit unknowns. Scoped refresh retains the declared affected coverage; missing reports can be resolved through direct inspection.

path.title: source exists: Choose the brownfield populator for existing code.
validate source shape: The skill validates its own preconditions.
bounded inspection: Inspect the selected source directly or delegate finite assignments within actual host permissions.

g.title: /ca:init: scaffold once. Create the enabled stub only when absent. Select the existing-code populator rather than treating the activation flag as completed initialization.

g.title: context-creation: confirm the source. Confirm meaningful code, an uninitialized context and primary source directories. Check actual host permissions before reading; ordinary work does not require a special scout profile.

g.title: context-creation: direct or delegated inspection. Inspect stack, infrastructure, architecture, security, testing and data model for initial/full work; scoped refresh covers affected categories. Optional agents receive finite assignments within host limits. Retain citations, source identities, conflicts and unknowns without secret values.

svg.title: Resolve the evidence gaps
svg.desc: skill: context-creation: source-backed synthesis → skill: context-creation: resolve or defer → skill: context-creation: write project state. Real values come from cited inspection and actual owner decisions. Uncertainty remains visible; independent solvable work need not wait for unrelated gaps.

text.font-family: Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

path.title: missing facts: Only the needed user facts are asked, not a second greenfield interview.
resolved or deferred: Apply supported claims and actual decisions while preserving human content, protected owners and explicit unknowns.

g.title: context-creation: source-backed synthesis. Turn inspected evidence into project, stack, standards, security and code-map records, each with its basis; source-observed records cite their source and are scoped to the paths they govern. Reinspect disputed or changed sources when useful; do not turn an inferred claim into a verified fact.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: context-creation: resolve or defer. Ask only missing material user-owned decisions. Record actual resolutions or explicit deferrals through the question owner. Real unresolved prerequisites stop dependent work; unrelated uncertainty stays visible without blocking independent work.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: context-creation: write project state. Write the records with knowledge.py add and update. Each write is checked and journaled by the native engine and is safe to retry; no per-document approval receipt is required. Board mutations retain their own helper; a release-target row remains conditional on real evidence or a resolved declaration.

svg.title: Bind sources and finish
svg.desc: skill: context-creation: cite evidence → skill: context-creation: initialization lock. The initialized marker and required files are present. The resulting evidence is inspectable; it is not a guarantee that every inferred claim is correct.

path.title: structural check: Initialization checks that the documents exist and parse, not that every question is answered.

g.title: context-creation: cite evidence. Each source-observed record cites the files it rests on, and each document keeps a baseline commit, so knowledge.py stale later lists exactly the records whose sources changed. Citations do not manufacture semantic review.

g.title: context-creation: initialization lock. For initial population only, knowledge.py initialize checks that the five knowledge documents exist and parse and the task board is well formed, then commits the marker. Unknown records and open questions do not prevent it. Initialized refresh retains its marker and never initializes again.
